label: Path sigma from independent arcs
subgoals: Look up each arc's sigma at its slew and load
Square and sum the arc sigmas
Take the square root as the path sigma

label: The n-sigma arrival
subgoals: Multiply the path sigma by the number of sigma
Add the two to get the late arrival

label: Why per-arc margins are pessimistic
subgoals: Compute the per-arc stacked margin as n times the sum of sigmas
Compute the POCV margin as n times the root-sum-square
Subtract to find the pessimism that per-arc margins add
